content.title: Stadium – Miami Freedom Park
content.text: A STADIUM THAT MATCHESTHE PULSE OF MIAMI Designed as a 25,000-seat, multi-purpose venue, the Nu Stadium at Miami Freedom Park reimagines the fan experience for the modern era. From electrifying soccer matches to world-class concerts and corporate events, every detail is crafted to create unforgettable moments, anchored by premium hospitality, seamless technology, and bold Miami energy. YOUR SEAT TO EVERY MOMENT From pitchside excitement to panoramic stadium views, Nu Stadium offers seating options for every type of supporter. Whether you want to feel the passion from the supporters' section, enjoy premium club access, or simply take in the match with an unbeatable view, every seat is crafted for comfort, energy, and unforgettable game days. Nu Stadium's private suites blend premium hospitality, exclusive service, and unrivaled views, creating a personalized environment for hosting clients, friends, and family. Enjoy private entrances, curated food and beverage offerings, and an atmosphere that puts you closer to the action — and the energy — than ever before. Whether you want to feel the passion from the supporters' section, enjoy premium club access, or simply take in the match with an unbeatable view, every seat is crafted for comfort, energy, and unforgettable game days. CONTACT US WHERE THE ENERGY NEVER STOPS. The Fan Zone at Nu Stadium is where the pulse of Inter Miami CF beats its strongest. This dynamic, open-air environment brings fans together before, during, and after the match with live entertainment, pop-up activations, curated food and drink, official merchandise, and more. It's not just a pre-game — it's a full day of connection, culture, and celebration for fans of all ages. REGISTER NOW INTER MIAMI CF: A GLOBAL ICON IN THE MAKING Inter Miami CF is more than a team — it's a movement inspiring fans across the globe and cementing Miami's place in the heart of the soccer world.
